newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ENDEMOL DIPS AFTER HALF-YEAR RESULTS.
newsitem.headline: ENDEMOL DIPS AFTER HALF-YEAR RESULTS.

text.p: Shares in Dutch television production group Endemol Entertainment slid 1.90 guilders, 3.11 percent, to 59.10 early on Tuesday after it posted a 19 percent jump in first half 1996/97 profits to 33.7 million guilders.
The results came in just below analysts' forecasts, which had ranged between 36 and 40 million guilders.
The company also reiterated its forecast that full-year earnings would rise between 15 and 20 percent.
"The results were a little disappointing although the forecast still looked positive," one dealer said.
